text:
Elena (mktg): Quick plan: run a 60-hour paid window for Oct 5 webinar. Goal: lower-funnel focus w/ RLSA layering + device bid adjustments. Need negative keyword list and device tiers by noon.

Josh (growth): Sounds good. Budget? markets?

Elena (mktg): $1,000/day US + EU for 2.5 days = $2,500. CPL target <$52, aim 70 regs. Primary markets: US, UK, DE, FR.

Priya (creative): I'll make two hero themes: "Technical path" and "Economics path". Recommend short-form CTAs for search and a carousel for retarget.

Omar (analytics): Tracking: add reg_uuid hidden field, GA4 event webinar_reg. Also plan to tag RLSA audiences with audience_tag={rlsa_lvl} so we can split first-click vs retarget.

Laila (ops): Routing: regs -> SFDC campaign "Oct5_Webinar_RLSA"; attended (>=30%) -> HubSpot SDR queue. Need Zap prod key after QA.

Josh (growth): Campaign structure idea:
- Search core: exact + phrase high-intent (12 keywords)
- RLSA: layer with 30/90-day site visitors and past webinar non-attenders
- Retarget: 7-day video viewers + 14-day LP visitors
- Device tiers: Mobile bid -10%, Desktop baseline, Tablet +5%

Elena (mktg): Negative keywords draft: "tutorial", "course", "internship", "free github", "examples". Add industry terms that pull students.

Priya (creative): Copy seeds (short):
H1-T: Production LLM inference 8min demo Oct 5
H1-E: Cut inference cost 8min live demo
Desc: Live demo + playable checklist. Seats limited.

Omar (analytics): KPI watch rules: if CPA > $65 after 18 hours -> tighten RLSA to 14-day only and reduce broad matches. If CTR <0.45% on search -> swap to Economics path creative.

Josh (growth): Bidding: Max conversions with tCPA $45. For RLSA layer, set higher bid multiplier +25% for 30-day visitors. Also enable dynamic keyword insertion for headlines where relevant.

Laila (ops): QA checklist: UTMs, reg_uuid, pixel firing, negative keyword list applied, device adjustments set, Zap to HubSpot staging test. I'll run staging tests.

adops-bot: Campaign skeleton created: id=cmp_oct5_rlsa_2019, draft_url=https://ads.internal/cmp_oct5_rlsa_2019

Elena (mktg): Can we do experiment: 70/30 traffic split to RLSA-lifted vs standard to measure uplift?

Omar (analytics): Yes. I'll set up incremental lift metric: compare conversion rate and CPA between both cohorts and build a dashboard tile.

Josh (growth): Swap rules: auto-switch creative if CTR <0.4% after 8 hours OR bounce rate from LP >68%. Also if mobile conv rate <50% of desktop, reduce mobile bid by further -15%.

Priya (creative): Uploading assets now to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/mktg/oct5_rlsa_assets (placeholder). Will include DKI-safe headlines.

Laila (ops): Staging Zap test passed. Requesting prod key after final review.

Elena (mktg): Final ask: apply an exclusion audience for customers and anyone who registered in last 90 days. Also add negative keyword "research paper" (no students).

adops-bot: Draft campaign cmp_oct5_rlsa_2019 moved to pending_review by Laila

Josh (growth): I'll monitor the first 6 hours and post hourly snapshots.

Omar (analytics): Setting alert: CPA > $60 -> @Josh + @Elena

Elena (mktg): Thanks all. Timeline: assets by 2pm, draft by 4pm, QA + go-live tomorrow 9am PT. End thread.
